title: pi-pasteboard configuration
description: Settings for the pi-pasteboard Pi extension. Every key is optional; environment variables of the same meaning take precedence over the file.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

root.description: Directory holding captured paste files. Must be a current-user-owned directory, not a symlink. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_ROOT.

minBytes.description: v1 whole-input capture threshold in bytes. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_MIN_BYTES.

minPasteBytes.description: v2 segmented capture floor: total referenced paste bytes below which pastes are left inline. 0 captures every paste. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_MIN_PASTE_BYTES.

maxSegments.description: Maximum number of parsed segments (typed and paste) in one submission; above it v2 declines and falls back to v1 whole-input capture. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_MAX_SEGMENTS.

ttlMs.description: Retention period for captured files, in milliseconds. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_TTL_MS.

debug.description: Emit debug-level diagnostics to stderr. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_DEBUG (0/false/no/off disables).

inlineFormat.description: Layout of a paste that stays inline (below minPasteBytes). "stock" = Pi's in-place expansion; "spaced" = its own block with a blank line either side. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_INLINE_FORMAT.

annotatePasteSize.description: Append "(812 lines, 45.6KB)" to each [paste saved: ...] reference so the model can choose grep over a full read. Overridden by PI_PASTEBOARD_ANNOTATE_SIZE.
